_comment: Sample Telegram Bot API Update payload for smoke-testing Template 02 (Customer Support) and Template 03 (Personal Assistant). Synthetic data based on the Telegram Bot API documentation. POST this body to your test-webhook URL with Content-Type: application/json. To exercise the secretToken check, also send the matching X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header (must equal the secretToken parameter on the n8n Webhook node).
